observations: A large maned creature occupies the center-left, its open mouth showing white teeth against dark gums, with one visible eye half-closed beneath heavy lashes.
The left half glows in soft amber-yellow while the right drops into near-black, splitting the figure sharply so warm and dark tones meet along its body.
Short overlapping marks in red, teal, orange, and blue run across the mane and torso, sitting visibly on top of darker underlayers rather than blending into them.
reading: The figure stands at the border between amber glow and deep black, teeth bared, eye half-lidded. That split reads less as aggression than as wariness—something holding its ground rather than charging. The layered colored marks across the mane give the surface a restless quality, the form dense with accumulated lines that never fully resolve into smooth fur or flat color.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors #127 and #129 show how sharply the series shifts: #127 is flat, high-key abstraction on orange; #129 is spare white line work on grey. #128 sits between them in density and tonal weight.

connections.reason: Scrimshaw7 places a face with bared teeth at center, surrounded by radiating colored marks crowding the edges—the same mark-over-mark density around an open-mouthed face that the collector links across these two artists.

Title neighbor #129 offers a direct contrast: spare white lines on grey with open negative space against #128's dense warm marks, making the shift in visual weight between the two immediately legible.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly does the amber light stop and the black begin along the figure's body, and what happens to the colored marks where they cross that boundary?
ambiguities: The creature combines features from multiple animals; no single identification is certain from the image alone.
Title neighbor #127 is fully abstract with no figurative element and is noted only for contextual contrast, not selected as a formal connection.

Scrimshaw7 connection confirmed: bared teeth centered in composition with radiating colored marks at edges is visible in that image, supporting the collector's cross-artist link.
